finding: imd_band missing for 1,111 rows (3.4%); missingness is informative (at-risk 34% vs 53% overall)
risk: Silent imputation would erase signal and distort fairness slices
action_or_limitation: 'Missing' becomes its own category in preprocessing

finding: imd_band label '10-20' lacks the % suffix unlike all other bands
risk: Category could be treated as distinct from '10-20%'

finding: 173 submitted assessments have no score; unsubmitted TMAs have no row at all
risk: Early-TMA features would mix 'not submitted' with 'scored 0'
action_or_limitation: Early-TMA features get a paired submitted-yes/no flag; missing score is never filled with 0

finding: 6,352 students (19.5%) unregistered on/before the cutoff day
risk: Their outcome is already known at prediction time; keeping them inflates recall
action_or_limitation: Population = still enrolled at cutoff; implemented in src/make_split.py; at-risk rate becomes 41.4%

finding: GGG-2014B has zero TMAs due by the cutoff
risk: Early-TMA features undefined for one course run
decision: Tolerate absence as a valid state
action_or_limitation: Features must handle 'no TMA due yet' via indicator + neutral value

finding: Module CCC exists only in 2014B/2014J so the 2013 training era has no CCC data
risk: Validation/test contain a course the model never saw; per-module scores confounded
decision: Decided before Model Gate (mentor-endorsed): keep CCC as a realistic cold-start case
action_or_limitation: Evaluation protocol fixed in advance: report headline metrics on the full test set AND on test excluding CCC; per-module metric table mandatory; CCC rows clearly marked as a course with no training data

finding: In the modeling population (after DQ-04), 558 validation and 678 test students (8.0% of test) also appear in train; on the raw dataset before filtering the counts are 940 and 972 (~9%) - both stated to avoid confusion
risk: Weak group leakage: same person on both sides in different course runs
action_or_limitation: Returning students exist in real deployment; features are presentation-specific; documented not removed. The authoritative numbers are the post-filtering ones in reports/split_summary.csv

finding: 45 rows missing date_registration; 8 rows unregistered before cutoff but marked Fail
risk: Negligible volume; odd records could confuse features
action_or_limitation: Missing registration date imputed + flagged; the 8 odd rows are excluded by the DQ-04 rule
